title: Past continuous: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: At nine o'clock last night, I ___ TV.
items.explanationEs: Con I, was; y el verbo con -ing: was watching.

items.prompt: They ___ for the bus when it started to rain.
items.explanationEs: Con they, were; y el verbo con -ing: were waiting.

items.statement: We were having lunch when you called.
items.explanationEs: La acción larga (having lunch) en pasado continuo; la corta, que la interrumpe (called), en pasado simple.
Know es un verbo de estado y no va en continuo: She knew the answer.

answers: What were you doing at eight?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta: what + were + sujeto + verbo con -ing. Con you, were.

answers: She wasn't listening to the teacher.
items.explanationEs: Negativa: wasn't + verbo con -ing. Didn't no se usa con was.
